+    return v * (a / (2.0*np.sin(a)))
+

+def quat_to_R(q):
+    w,x,y,z = q
+    return np.array([[1-2*(y*y+z*z), 2*(x*y-z*w), 2*(x*z+y*w)],

+    import mujoco
+    q = np.zeros(4)
+    mujoco.mju_mat2Quat(q, R.reshape(-1))
+    return q
+
+
+def pose_servo(s, target_pos, target_R, hand_target, n, kp=2.0, kr=2.0):
+    bid = s.model.body("palmworld").id

+        q = s.data.qpos[s._jq].copy()

+        R = s.data.xmat[bid].reshape(3,3).copy()
+        ep = target_pos - p
+        er = rot_error(target_R, R)
+        v = np.r_[kp*ep, kr*er]
+        # Bound the Cartesian command before applying the damped differential IK.
+        if np.linalg.norm(v[:3]) > 0.30: v[:3] *= 0.30/np.linalg.norm(v[:3])
+        if np.linalg.norm(v[3:]) > 1.5: v[3:] *= 1.5/np.linalg.norm(v[3:])
